messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "towel_service=true although the user declined towel service.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the policy by **inventing a value for the optional `towel_service` argument**, setting it to `true` despite the user explicitly stating they do not need towel service. This violates the explicit prohibition on inventing values for optional arguments (q15). While all other prerequisites (certification, free slot, confirmation, and session limit) are satisfied, this single violation is sufficient to classify the action as an ERROR."}}
